description: Signal whether a recalled memory was useful or irrelevant. Helps improve future recall quality over time. Use after recalling memories to indicate which were helpful vs noise.

memory_id.description: The memory ID to give feedback on

signal.description: "useful" boosts the memory's ranking, "irrelevant" reduces its importance. For skills, "useful" boosts confidence, "irrelevant" reduces it.

name: feedback_memory
